name: @spark901/meeting-summary-ui
description: Reusable React components for rendering a civic-archive meeting summary: a meeting card, an agenda-item list, a Download PDF button, and the mandatory transcript-accuracy-caveat banner. Built against @spark901/meeting-summary-schema's types so it never drifts from what a producer emits. Not published to a registry — no build step; consumers import the TypeScript source directly. Self-contained Tailwind utility classes only, no dependency on any one app's component library, so it stays reusable for a future civic-archive town page.
